summary: Sega's 1988 top-down multiplayer arcade racer on System 24 hardware, later ported to major European home computers by Activision.

entries.title: Hot Rod

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation or original hardware; original cabinet layout matters most for multiplayer authenticity.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Sega System 24 arcade presentation with modern scaling

primary.why: Hot Rod was developed by Sega for System 24 arcades and shipped in four-player cocktail-style and three-player upright cabinets before lower-fidelity Activision home-computer ports. The arcade version preserves the intended multiplayer cabinet presentation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; use the four-player cocktail cabinet where possible for the intended multiplayer layout.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Sega System 24 arcade release with four-player cocktail-style and three-player upright cabinet options.
